# Senior UAT & Business Analyst – QA / Test Automation
**Vendor:** Rose International
**Job Type:** Contract – W2/C2C
**Work Mode:** Hybrid
**Location:** Atlanta, GA – **Local Atlanta candidates only**
**Experience:** 5+ Years
**Interview:** Not Specified
### Work Authorization
USC, GC, GC-EAD, H4-EAD, OPT-EAD, STEM-OPT
**No H1B / No Fake Profiles**
### Tax Terms
W2 | C2C | 1099
### Required Skills
* UAT / User Acceptance Testing
* Business Analysis
* QA & Test Automation
* Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, UFT, TestComplete, or Power Automate
* Jira, Azure DevOps, Azure Test Plans
* Functional, Regression, Integration & End-to-End Testing
* Test Strategy, Test Plans, Test Cases & Test Scripts
* Requirements Management & Acceptance Criteria
* Data Validation, Reconciliation & SQL
* Power BI / Microsoft Fabric
* Defect Management & Root Cause Analysis
### Key Responsibilities
* Lead UAT activities for enterprise applications and projects.
* Gather, analyze, document, and validate business/functional requirements.
* Develop UAT strategies, test plans, scenarios, test cases, and scripts.
* Perform manual and automated testing across functional, regression, integration, E2E, and UAT environments.
* Create and maintain automated regression test suites.
* Manage defects through logging, triage, prioritization, retesting, and closure.
* Track testing progress, coverage, defect trends, risks, and quality metrics.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, SMEs, developers, vendors, and project managers.
* Participate in JAR/JAD sessions, requirements walkthroughs, testing reviews, and knowledge transfer.
* Support production validation, release readiness, and continuous QA improvement.
### Preferred Qualifications
* Agile/Scrum experience.
* ETL, data pipelines, and data warehousing knowledge.
* Experience with .NET, Angular, and relational databases.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel, Word, and SharePoint.
* Experience with automated testing frameworks.
* Knowledge of **Georgia Gateway Integrated Eligibility System** is highly desirable.
* Government eligibility-system experience is a plus.
### Education
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field. Equivalent education and relevant professional experience may be considered.
For Submission

ETL QA Engineer – Python & SQL
Job Title: ETL QA Engineer
Experience: 10+ Years
Location: Remote
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and execute ETL testing strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.
Perform end-to-end testing of ETL/ELT data pipelines, data ingestion, transformation, and data loading processes.
Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and reconciliation across source and target systems.
Write complex SQL queries for data validation, reconciliation, transformation verification, and backend testing.
Develop Python scripts and automation frameworks for data validation and ETL test automation.
Automate repetitive data quality and validation checks using Python.
Validate source-to-target mappings, business transformation rules, aggregations, joins, and calculations.
Perform data warehouse testing across staging, integration, and reporting layers.
Test batch and scheduled data pipelines and investigate data discrepancies and failures.
Perform database testing, including stored procedures, views, functions, indexes, and complex queries.
Analyze ETL job failures and work closely with developers and data engineers to identify root causes.
Validate data across relational databases, cloud data platforms, APIs, and flat files.
Participate in regression, integration, system, functional, and performance testing of data applications.
Build and maintain automated test suites using Python and applicable testing frameworks such as PyTest.
Execute data reconciliation and perform record-level and aggregate-level comparisons between source and target systems.
Work with CI/CD pipelines to integrate automated ETL/data validation tests into the development lifecycle.
Track defects using tools such as JIRA and collaborate with development, data engineering, and business teams.
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and provide testing estimates and status updates.
Required Skills
7+ years of experience in ETL/Data QA or Data Warehouse Testing.
Strong hands-on experience with Python for test automation and data validation.
Strong expertise in SQL, including complex queries, joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, and aggregations.
Strong experience with ETL/ELT testing and data pipeline validation.
Experience with source-to-target mapping and data reconciliation.
Strong understanding of Data Warehouse concepts, ETL processes, dimensional modeling, fact and dimension tables.
Experience testing large-volume datasets and complex data transformations.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or equivalent.
Experience with PyTest or similar Python testing frameworks.
Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, ALM, or Azure DevOps.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
